subject: Fix minor fd leak in rdbSaveToSlavesSockets (#12919)
reason: The change adds one close(server.rdb_child_exit_pipe) solely in the parent's fork-failure branch of rdbSaveToSlavesSockets (rdb.c:3639, the childpid == -1 cleanup). The successful diskless-replication path already manages that fd correctly (kept open, then closed by backgroundSaveDoneHandlerSocket at rdb.c:3488 or on pipe EOF at replication.c:1551), so the added line never runs on any normal full resync. The only way to reach it is to make redisFork() fail during a diskless RDB-to-slaves-sockets transfer, which requires exhausting process/memory resource limits (root/ulimit control the runs do
